```python
# 1. 列出所有機場
airports = list_all_airports()

# 2. 取得第一個和最後一個機場代碼
from_code = airports[0]
to_code = airports[-1]

# 3. 計算商務艙票價
flight_cost_response = get_flight_cost(
    travel_from=from_code,
    travel_to=to_code,
    travel_date="2024-10-31",
    travel_class="business"
)

estimated_total = flight_cost_response["cost"]
```
